name: 1Password
description: Connects one 1Password vault to Cockpit's vault, so agents can use its items without ever seeing a value: vault_run starts a command you approve with the secret in its environment. Uses a 1Password service account through the official `op` CLI (version 2.18.0 or later, installed on this machine or pinned on PATH). The service account must read exactly one vault, ideally a separate one such as "Agents"; a token that reads more is refused. Needs Cockpit's credential encryption to be on: the token is stored encrypted by the vault and handed to `op` only as OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN in its environment.
author: Cockpit
